source_en: Hello. Mom helped with the form. Ksenia Darnik. I'm eleven.
School on Lenina Street is quiet now. Lots of empty desks.
Mom's working. I know the way, and I don't talk to anyone.
Away. Or sick. Teacher says we pretend they're on holiday.
I found a shiny stone on the way here. I don't know why I picked it up.
No. It's warm. It likes my pocket.
By the old fence on the east road. There were lots. I only took one.
I checked my papers three times. ...You blink a lot.
